arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_booking', booking_id, json_object('request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending') UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',request_id,json_object('step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('price',price_cents,'version',version,'capacity',capacity) FROM flights

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('price',price_cents,'version',version,'capacity',capacity) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'related_booking',b.booking_id,json_object('request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'cancel',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' OR b.client_reference IN (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='pending') UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending') UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',request_id,json_object('step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'confirmed_missing_backing' AS check_name, count(*) AS violations FROM bookings b WHERE status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)<>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id AND i.flight_id=b.flight_id AND i.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_still_backed',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_refund',count(*) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND c.state='captured' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.charge_id=c.charge_id AND r.booking_id=c.booking_id AND r.amount_cents=c.amount_cents) UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sale',count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_request_confirmed',count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold',count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_hold',count(*) FROM holds h LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.flight_id<>h.flight_id OR b.passenger_id<>h.passenger_id UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_bookings',count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_events',count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'refunds',sum(amount_cents) FROM refunds
